stories.title: US teens can access ‘nudify’ apps despite Apple and Google’s parental controls, report finds
stories.summary: A Tech Transparency Project test using accounts presented as 13-year-olds reportedly downloaded 135 apps capable of generating non-consensual nude imagery despite Apple and Google parental controls. The issue has had real-world consequences, including an allegation that a Pennsylvania student used an AI image-editing app to make pornographic material from another student’s image.
